technical_checks: All 124 images are 48x48 and fully opaque. No file is failed merely for RGB/RGBA mode or low palette count.
view_judgement: Three-quarter overhead with a visible roof and south/front facade is correct. No file is failed for having front windows or for not being pure top-down.
season_judgement: House, building and field geometry visually remains in the same locations across seasons; no seasonal-layout mismatch was found.
farmstead_judgement: The house footprints are acceptable; these were not failed as shrunken signposts. Repeating a single setting farmstead in a stress layout is not itself a rejection reason. Failures identify ground treatment, lane/hedge issues and individual architectural detail.
other_limits: No transparency, building-edge clipping, blur or anti-aliasing defect is asserted without visual evidence. Farmland colours are muted, not rejected as saturated checkerboards.
